scene.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a broad public seaside staircase at dawn — she pauses during an early walk and tastes a long twisted sesame pastry; a retro American diner — strums a small ukulele; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; an indoor planetarium demonstration nook — she playfully raises a little folded paper rocket toward the ceiling projection; her bedroom — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — lying on her left side; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lying on her left side; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — coils the cable of a microphone loosely around her hand; a stairwell landing with a tall window — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing
